charge_port.notes: Estimated: VW 2021 launch release (ConceptCarz): CCS socket; thinkEV Canada 2026 lists CCS1; VW sells an adapter for Supercharger use through MY2026 (vw.com), so no native NACS port found for any ID.4 year.

supercharger_access.notes: VW Canada: NACS DC adapter officially available for the ID.4 (US and Canada); Electrek: access from 2025-11-18 for ID.4 owners with a $200 (CAD 304) adapter; MY2026+ VW EVs include it; vw.com 2026 page: adapter sold separately. No model years excluded.

wheels.notes: Estimated: 2021 ID.4 Pro AWD page shows 19x8; 2024 assumed unchanged (2025 and 2026 Pro RWD pages also show 19). Carried from another model year or trim, not read for this exact trim and year.
